children: Inflation expectations reversed in September, with investors anticipating lower instead of higher global consumer prices over the next 12 months, according to the latest Bank of America global fund manager survey. A net 4% of investors expect global inflation to ease, flipping from a net 3% expecting higher inflation in August. (renae.dyer@wsj.com)
